purpose: Correct the pose-graph propagation substrate before drift-correction breadth. No new optimizer or real-motion accuracy claim.

fixed_contract.composition: Keep the existing to_T_anchor = to_T_from * from_T_anchor algebra. This method's stored graph isometries map the common anchor into each node; callers explicitly invert when they need the opposite direction.
fixed_contract.reachability: Only directed non-loop edges reachable from the requested root participate. Disconnected nodes and components remain byte-for-byte unchanged; disconnected incoming edges cannot move the root or its descendants.
fixed_contract.topology: The reachable non-loop component must be a directed tree. Reject self/cyclic edges, duplicate constraints and multiple incoming paths with MappingError::Graph. Loop-closure constraints remain stored and are ignored by this propagation method.
fixed_contract.updates: Propagate complete f32 isometries including pure rotation and sub-1e-4 translation, without convergence thresholds. Pin the original root and preserve every target timestamp and all edge records.
fixed_contract.failure: Validate reachable topology, finite root/constraints and finite composed results before committing any node update. Missing root or any failure leaves all graph records unchanged.
fixed_contract.execution: Iterative deterministic breadth-first traversal with adjacency indexing; O(V+E) work/storage bounded by the supplied graph, no recursion, repeated relaxation, new threads, dependencies or device transfers.

verification: Commit independent public-API regression tests first and retain the failing original run. Check hand-calculated transformed basis/origin points for noncommuting rotations and nonidentity roots, reverse edge order, tiny translations, reachability, timestamps, root pinning, loop exclusion, atomic topology/finite failures, missing root and a long chain. Then test default/all mapping features, Clippy, WASM and formatting; exercise existing scan and cross-crate north-star integration.

resources.preservation: Hash-protect all existing scientific JSON under the external maturity data root, all 42 frozen native artifacts, pinned reference sources and completed room audit outputs. Do not rebuild or overwrite frozen binaries/wheels; reuse the existing Cargo cache. Preserve failed runs and exact source commits.

remaining_80_percent: Native complete room accuracy and genuinely unobserved motion qualification; both qualifying raw Linux hardware classes; matching canonical measured clock uncertainty and physical frame accuracy; full canonical mapping/semantic/Viewer/interchange/release acceptance. This graph fix cannot satisfy these requirements by itself.
